readings: For each transref in sentimentandfundamentals, compute the average anlycount, ignoring NULLs. Compute the overall average as the simple unweighted mean of these per-transref averages. Keep only the transrefs whose average is strictly above that overall average. For each kept transref, show transref, its average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the mean of the kept transrefs' per-transref averages (an unweighted mean of the kept averages). Return the top 10 ordered by that last difference, highest first, with NULLs last. Do not round.

For each transref in sentimentandfundamentals, compute the average anlycount, ignoring NULLs. Compute the overall average as the simple unweighted mean of these per-transref averages. Keep only the transrefs whose average is strictly above that overall average. For each kept transref, show transref, its average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the pooled average anlycount over all non-NULL underlying rows belonging to the kept transrefs (a row-weighted mean, not a mean of averages). Return the top 10 ordered by that last difference, highest first, with NULLs last. Do not round.
queries:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS overall_avg FROM per
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anly, o.overall_avg
  FROM per p, overall o
  WHERE p.avg_anly > o.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS kmean FROM kept
)
SELECT k.transref,
       k.avg_anly AS avg_anlycount,
       k.avg_anly - k.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       k.avg_anly - km.kmean AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept k, kept_mean km
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH per AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_a) AS overall_avg
  FROM per
  WHERE avg_a IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_a
  FROM per p, overall o
  WHERE p.avg_a > o.overall_avg
),
pooled AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.anlycount) AS pooled_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  WHERE s.transref IN (SELECT transref FROM kept)
    AND s.anlycount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT k.transref,
       k.avg_a AS avg_anlycount,
       k.avg_a - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
       k.avg_a - p.pooled_avg AS diff_from_pooled_avg
FROM kept k, overall o, pooled p
ORDER BY (k.avg_a - p.pooled_avg) IS NULL, (k.avg_a - p.pooled_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10;
